reference.title: Activation Function Optimization Scheme for Image Classification

implementation_notes: This is a reference configuration; the existing main.py does not load it yet.
The paper specifies five replications but does not specify numerical seed values.
Dropout probability and train/validation split seed are not specified in the cited parameter sections.
Table 2 starts with 28 convolution filters and lists no intermediate Dense layers; the existing fitness.py differs.
Section 3.1.1 lists 19 unary and 11 binary functions; the existing search samples 17 unary and 7 binary indices.
